page.layout: One column of verse, full width, indented lines beginning new sentences. Running head at the top above the text. No page number, catchword or signature.

main_text.l: Delitijs, facie cælíque lacúsque fruuntor,
Et Iuræ aspectu, Rhodaníque liquentibus vndis.
Quid dicam vrticas labris vbi coxit ahenis
Rusticus, & densum expressit radicibus humorem
Inuergensque sero pingui, iam cogit, & infert

l.i: Lactea fiscellis informans liba sub vmbra:
Hinc tibi caseoli, quorum sapor omnibus vnus
Præstiterit, nobisque seri de nomine dicti.
Sed quid pingue illud veluti nubecula, multram [?]
Et quod in angusta crebris dum tunditur olla
Ictibus, in crassum quanto mage vapulat, exit:
Ac tandem longo solidum fit verbere corpus?
Per medios æstus, nostris hæ scilicet illæ
Hic montis sunt deliciæ, queis Loton Vlyssis,
Queis nec prætulerit Batauo sub iudice quisquam

main_text.l: Haud leuia hæc vrbis sunt ornamenta beatæ
(Exteriora licet) largo Pater optimus imbre
Quæ fundit; rebusque suos hic ditat opimis.
Herbarum quoque terra ferax, succique potentis
Innumeras circùm doctis alit vsibus aptas,
Et quas vel medici non agnouére priores.
Assuetæ fluuio volucres ripisque sonoris,
Seu quæ rura colunt, vrbésque aut aspera montis,
Sedibus hic errant varijs circúmque supráque.
Quæ verò hic habitant, quas non doƈto ordine solers
Digeris & multo lustras apprimà labore
Textor in antiquis consummatissime chartis?
Quid cælum aeriæque plagæ, ventíque salubres?
Purior hic cæli campos habet æthra patentes,
Prospeƈtúmque loci grato quoque terminat arcu
Iura, vbi nox fugiens séque & sua sydera condit.
Quà verò lux alma diem mortalibus affert,

page.notes: Lines 6–17 appear in italic type and are marked as such; the italic boundaries elsewhere are uncertain. "multram" in line 9 is a doubtful reading (possibly "multam" with a ligature) and is marked [?]. The ligatures ct and st are rendered as plain letters. Long s is written as s throughout. Printed accents (ú, é, ì, ó) are kept as they appear on the scan; the printed "vdo" and "Quà" are copied as printed.
